color-primary.label: Primary
color-primary.note: Buttons, links and accents. The lighter and darker shades follow it. Pair with On primary.

color-on-primary.label: On primary
color-on-primary.note: Text and icons on a primary background. Keep enough contrast with Primary.

color-primary-lighter.label: Primary lighter
color-primary-lighter.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-primary-darker.label: Primary darker
color-primary-darker.note: Hover and active states. Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-secondary.label: Secondary
color-secondary.note: Second accent color. The lighter and darker shades follow it.

color-on-secondary.label: On secondary
color-on-secondary.note: Text and icons on a secondary background. Keep enough contrast with Secondary.

color-secondary-lighter.label: Secondary lighter
color-secondary-lighter.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.

color-secondary-darker.label: Secondary darker
color-secondary-darker.note: Set it only to pick a shade by hand.
